ev.q: During 2007-2008, the average daily intake of kilocalories was 2,504 kilocalories for men and 1,771 kilocalories for women.
Source: Wright JD, Wang CY. Trends in intake of energy and macronutrients in adults from 1999--2000 through 2007--2008.
Source: Wright JD, Wang CY. Trends in intake of energy and macronutrients in adults from 1999--2000 through 2007--2008.

methods_quotes.q: Based on responses to a series of questions in the 24-hour dietary recall interview of the National Health and Nutrition Examination Survey.
For both men and women, the percentages do not add up to 100% because calories consumed as alcohol were excluded.
